methodology.selection: latest successful receipt by started_at, with unsuccessful attempts retained

methodology.fact_probes: all source-checked phrases must occur; presence alone does not prove correct association
methodology.diagram_probes: label presence only, not circuit topology or switch state understanding
methodology.tables: native structured tables, not HTML/Markdown syntax counts; source tables can span pages
methodology.table_relationships: exact row-label anchor with expected values in overlapping cells, honoring native rowSpan
methodology.runtime: single observed run per input; client durations are not statistically comparable benchmarks
methodology.cost: unknown; no invoice or monetary estimate computed
